name: STS CLI
description: Oracle Simphony STS Gen2 from your terminal: authentication, explicit requests and unchanged STS responses.
agentGuidance: Run sts --help and sts endpoints to discover commands. List companies and select exact <companyCode>@<authHostname> keys; do not guess from shorthand. Successful login selects its company. Before API calls, all due profiles renew; expired tokens are removed and require login. Help/local/dry-run commands stay offline. STS API bodies stay verbatim: inline up to 16 KiB and 500 lines; above either limit, private files with compact JSON references. Filter/read selected file data instead of loading it all into context. Local commands return JSON, diagnostics go to stderr. Successful non-quiet STS calls check npm daily and notify on stderr if newer; version --check forces a lookup. Ask before installing updates; nothing installs automatically.
